mainEntity.name: Is Floatboat a drop-in replacement for Claude Cowork?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Cowork is a desktop cowork agent for user-initiated tasks. Floatboat is Calendar-Driven, triggered by events and deadlines.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Claude models inside Floatboat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Floatboat docs, Claude is among built-in frontier models without separate API key setup.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to stop using Claude Cowork if I adopt Floatboat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Many solopreneurs use cowork tools for exploratory work and Calendar-Driven agents for scheduled operations.

mainEntity.name: What if I only want free open-source alternatives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Floatboat is not open source. Review Eigent or OpenWork for free Cowork-style desktop agents.

mainEntity.name: Which tool is better for meeting preparation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Calendar-Driven systems fit recurring auto-triggered prep. Cowork helps when you manually start prep each time.
